commitResults.messageTitle: Customize agent guidance for student profile
Rename chatbot from Duke to CatGPT
Complete Level-0 greeting and exit behavior
Complete Level-1 command echo and exit handling
Complete Level-2 task addition and listing
Complete Level-3 task status tracking with mark and unmark
Complete Level-4 typed todo, deadline, and event tasks
Complete Level-5 validation and exception-based error handling
Complete Level-6 task deletion with validated task selection
Replace task type strings with enum for safer task categorization

commitResults.messageBody:
CatGPT loses all tasks when the application exits.

Persist task data in an OS-independent relative path. Create missing
directories and report invalid saved data safely.

CatGPT needs to preserve tasks between sessions.

Integrate the completed Level-7 storage implementation into master while
retaining the required branch history.

Deadline dates are stored as unvalidated text, preventing reliable
validation and consistent formatting.

Represent tasks as objects and store deadline dates as LocalDate. Accept
ISO yyyy-MM-dd input and display dates as MMM dd yyyy while preserving
saved task state.

CatGPT needs to validate and format deadline dates consistently.

Integrate the completed Level-8 date handling into master while
retaining the required branch history.

CatGPT handles parsing, task storage, and user interaction in one
class, making the application difficult to extend.

Extract Ui, Parser, TaskList, and task subclasses so each class owns a
focused responsibility while preserving existing behavior and storage.

The application classes are located in the default package, which
makes the growing codebase harder to organize.

Move all Java classes into the catgpt package so the source structure
matches Java package conventions and supports future build tooling.

Manual compilation does not provide a repeatable build process or
dependency management.

Integrate the official Gradle wrapper and configure the application
plugin to run CatGPT using its packaged main class.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit tests for parser and task list
commitResults.messageBody:
Parsing and task collection behavior lacks automated regression
coverage.

Add JUnit tests for valid and invalid commands, task creation, status
updates, and task-list mutations so Gradle can detect regressions.

The Gradle configuration still names the packaged application after
the starter chatbot.

Generate the executable shadow JAR as catgpt.jar so the distributed
artifact matches the application name.

Several switch blocks and Javadoc comments do not follow the
required Java coding standard.

Align switch cases with the prescribed indentation and standardize
Javadoc descriptions so the codebase follows the course conventions.

Users cannot locate related tasks without manually reading the
entire task list.

Add a find command that selects tasks containing a supplied keyword
while preserving their original order and displaying clear results.

Apply the course Java coding standard to the main development branch
while retaining the required parallel branch history.

Integrate task search into the coding-standard-compliant main
branch while retaining the required parallel branch history.
